address: Rua Gustavo Sampaio, 361 - Loja A, Rio de Janeiro, 22010-010, Brazil
bio: If you're looking for a restaurant close to the beach — in this case Leme beach, just north of Copacabana and a touch quieter and more family-friendly — this is a truly excellent choice, with a wonderfully casual atmosphere and under the direction of chef Andressa Cabral, well known for her starring role as a presenter on the television programme Iron Chef Brasil. Inside, the space surprises with its many pumpkin-shaped light fittings and a counter where you can also eat, and serves up heartfelt cooking rooted in Brazilian tradition, with well-updated dishes and fascinating African influences. The menu, with its very accessible prices, features some unmissable dishes — among them the delicious bolinho de banana com carne seca, a fried banana and salt-cod cake, and the so-called Peixe à Inajá, a heartfelt tribute to Dona Carmem Virginia, a towering figure in ancestral Brazilian cooking and in everything relating to female empowerment.
